scope: Local production chunk context/search text/BM25 SQL/query plan/lexical eligible predicate; no vector, reranker or generated answer

dataset.groundTruth: Selected physical pages visually inspected with PDFKit; private question text not committed

limitations: Not a whole Hybrid RAG pass/fail or accuracy rate
Vector score could retain a candidate rejected in lexical-only checks
No generated answer, formula transcription or semantic correctness checked
Comparison lexical eligibility covers subject-specific branch; not only canonical gate
Hypothesis uses the same observed sample; not a holdout evaluation
No account/source/folder isolation claim from one private source
Normalizer changes require stored index compatibility or explicit reindexing before adoption
